1. DETAILED SYSTEM ARCHITECTURES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### System A: Praxirence Ambient Clinical Intelligence
- Timeline: Started September 2026 – Present
- Target User: Practicing physicians, medical staff, OPD clinics, and patients.
- Problem Statement: Administrative documentation burnout (consuming up to 40% of clinician time) and patient lack of visibility into clinical instructions and prescription regimens.
- Front-End Architecture:
  * Doctor Native Android App built with React Native and Expo. Integrates live audio waveform visualization, instant patient queue triage, and one-tap prescription approval.
  * Patient Native Android App featuring passwordless phone OTP authentication, digital health vault, prescription viewer, and interactive care guidance assistant.
- Back-End & ML Architecture:
  * FastAPI Python 3.11 asynchronous API layer running on GPU-accelerated microservices.
  * Speech-to-Text: OpenAI Whisper-Small fine-tuned on specialized clinical conversational corpora using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) at FP16 precision.
  * Clinical Synthesis: Mistral-7B-Instruct fine-tuned with 4-bit Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) to transform doctor-patient dialogue into structured Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan (SOAP) clinical documentation with 0.92 ROUGE-1 score.
  * Drug Contraindication Engine: Automated cross-referencing of active patient regimens against medication databases to flag dosage hazards and allergen conflicts.
- Security & Compliance:
  * Fully compliant with the Indian Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 and US HIPAA rules.
  * Ephemeral in-memory audio chunk processing: raw audio is shredded immediately following inference with zero permanent audio persistence.
  * Database fields protected with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest; HMAC-SHA256 blind indexing prevents cleartext identity linkage.

### System B: Agricultural Vision & Spectral Analytics System
- Timeline: Started June 2026 – Present
- Affiliation: Christ (Deemed to be University) — CS Department / School of Sciences.
- Funding: Stipend-Funded Research Grant.
- Objective: Authenticity verification and botanical classification across 2,300 physical agricultural specimens (Groundnut, Soybean, Banana, Sapota).
- Multimodal Pipeline:
  * Ingestion of raw benchtop digital photography (>12MP) paired with 400nm–1000nm Vis-NIR diffuse reflectance spectral signatures captured via Theremino spectrometers.
  * Stage 1: Lanczos-3 proportional sinc-windowed downsampling bounded at 1200px, avoiding aliasing artifacts while preserving surface lenticels.
  * Stage 2: Neural salient object segmentation using U2-Net (nested ReS-UNet) producing continuous floating-point alpha mattes to separate specimens from shadow and clutter.
  * Stage 3: Porter-Duff Over alpha compositing onto pure white (#FFFFFF) canvases.
  * Stage 4: Dynamic bounding-box auto-centering with 15% contextual padding.
- Dataset Scale: 11,500 standardized artifacts with deterministic canonical naming (CU_SDD_...) and balanced 50:50 organic/conventional representation.

### System C: Wholesale & Retail E-Commerce Platform (Roshan Enterprises)
- Domain: Commercial wholesale and retail inventory distribution.
- Stack: React 19, Vite, Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, Vanilla CSS.
- Key Accomplishments:
  * Built dual purchasing flows enabling guest retail browsing as well as tiered bulk wholesale pricing.
  * Utilized react-window virtualization to maintain smooth 60fps scrolling across high-volume product catalogs.
  * Zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) with responsive viewport adaptation.

### System D: Credex AI Spend Audit
- Domain: SaaS and AI cloud spend optimization for startups.
- Stack: Next.js 15, React, Tailwind CSS, Anthropic Claude SDK, Supabase, GSAP.
- Key Accomplishments:
  * Interactive financial calculator calibrated in Indian Rupee (INR ₹) lakh and crore denominations.
  * Floating AI advisory agent leveraging Claude for real-time cost reduction recommendations.

### System E: Nexus Scholar
- Domain: Scientific research intelligence and knowledge graphs.
- Stack: React 18, Vite, PostgreSQL, pgvector (768d embeddings), Prisma, FastAPI.
- Key Accomplishments:
  * Automated extraction of RDF-like semantic triples from arXiv publications.
  * Real-time 2D/3D force-directed graph canvas for cross-discipline discovery.
